sections.heading: Current solicitations › Vacant Commercial Spaces Funding Program
paragraphs: This funding opportunity is being issued by the Mayor’s Office of Housing and Community Development (“MOHCD”). Respondents must be nonprofit entities that are capable of entering into contracts with the city, meet the requirement of city funding, and demonstrate the need for financial support to complete necessary build-out of vacant commercial spaces for occupancy.
More information on the Vacant Commercial Spaces Funding Program

sections.heading: Current solicitations › Housing Authority Integration Technical Assistance
paragraphs: This Request for Proposals (“solicitation”) is being issued by the Mayor’s Office of Housing and Community Development (“MOHCD”). MOHCD is seeking qualified suppliers to provide technical assistance and policy expertise as it relates to updating MOHCD programs to provide for integration of housing authority functions within MOHCD’s housing work. Refer to the documents below for additional information.

Housing Authority Integration Technical Assistance RFP Attachment 1 P-600 (01-26) Professional Services Agreement Attachment 2 HCAO Declaration Attachment 3 MCO Declaration Attachment 4 First Source Hiring Plan Attachment 5 Form126 f4 Housing Authority Integration Technical Assistance RFP Q&A
